note: Horizontal elbow, rear, rebuilt (step 4). The old one landed with the arm half open and the shoulder turned past its range (17-28 degrees, tests/strikes4.js): it read as a short straight. An elbow is the forearm folded TIGHT, the fist by his own head, and the point of the elbow swung across at head height by the hips and shoulders — the hand travels with the elbow rather than out in front of it. A step in first: it's the shortest weapon he has.

keys.note: loaded: the rear hand up by his own ear, the elbow lifted out to the side at shoulder height, the hips turned back
impact: hips and shoulders turned through, the elbow come across at head height with the forearm folded flat in front of his own face
